sample.bug_detail_desc: 在如999這類需要進位的輸入而進入最後一個進位處理邏輯時，沒有將原始位數-1造成回傳結果多一位，導致類似邊緣情況的輸入無法獲得正確輸出

patchs_eval.reparied_code:
def next_palindrome(digit_list):
    n = len(digit_list)
    high_mid = n // 2
    low_mid = (n - 1) // 2
    all_nines = True
    for digit in digit_list:
        if digit != 9:
            all_nines = False
            break
    if all_nines:
        return [1] + [0] * (n - 1) + [1]
    for i in range((n + 1) // 2):
        digit_list[-(i + 1)] = digit_list[i]
    if digit_list <= digit_list[::-1]:
        carry = 1
        i = low_mid
        while i >= 0 and carry != 0:
            new_digit = digit_list[i] + carry
            carry = new_digit // 10
            digit_list[i] = new_digit % 10
            digit_list[-(i + 1)] = digit_list[i]
            i -= 1
    return digit_list


print(next_palindrome([1, 2, 9]))
print(next_palindrome([9, 9, 9]))

def next_palindrome(digit_list):
    n = len(digit_list)
    if n == 0:
        return [1]
    mid = n // 2
    left = mid - 1
    right = mid if n % 2 == 0 else mid + 1
    while left >= 0 and digit_list[left] == digit_list[right]:
        left -= 1
        right += 1
    need_to_increment = (left < 0) or digit_list[left] < digit_list[right]
    left = mid - 1
    right = mid if n % 2 == 0 else mid + 1
    if need_to_increment:
        carry = 1
        if n % 2 == 1:
            digit_list[mid] += 1
            carry = digit_list[mid] // 10
            digit_list[mid] %= 10
            right = mid + 1
        while left >= 0:
            digit_list[left] += carry
            carry = digit_list[left] // 10
            digit_list[left] %= 10
            digit_list[right] = digit_list[left]
            left -= 1
            right += 1
    while left >= 0:
        digit_list[right] = digit_list[left]
        left -= 1
        right += 1
    if need_to_increment and carry:
        digit_list = [1] + [0] * (n - 1) + [1]
    return digit_list


print(next_palindrome([1, 2, 3]))
print(next_palindrome([9, 9, 9]))
print(next_palindrome([1, 2, 2, 1]))
